  1 ≤ n ∧ 1 ≤ m →
    Smooth (ubar u q) →
      normSq q = 1 →
        UnitValued (ubar u q) →
          WaveMapEnergy.Normal (ubar u q) →
            CompactPerturbation (ubar u q) q →
              ∀ (t : ℝ),
                0 < t →
                  Integrable (fun x => density (ubar u q) x t) volume ∧
                    DifferentiableAt ℝ (energy (ubar u q)) t ∧ deriv (energy (ubar u q)) t = 0
